audioWithoutPresenter.caption: timeline.captions or timeline.subtitles
audioWithoutPresenter.presenter: Omit timeline.presenter; do not invent a native hide-presenter switch.
audioWithoutPresenter.preserve: Complete original narration, actual caption/word evidence and supplied media; no blank presenter video or fabricated timing.

inputRoutingContract.native: Native scene media requirements remain mandatory. Public route documentation is not implementation of a new hide-presenter or pure-audio native mode.
inputRoutingContract.legacyComponents: The console mode=components route still imports presenter video. It is not the workflow=motion-kit route.
inputRoutingContract.assistant: Choose the supported route from the existing request/materials. Do not ask the user to select technical modes, resend existing materials, or fill a technical form. Existing approved projects stay on their route.

captionRendering.instruction: The generic renderer displays complete sentence cues. Do not pass units/semanticBreakAfter as a promise of word highlighting. Retain the original ASR word records separately; bind unchanged complete s/e/text cues. No word clock is fabricated or altered.

example.scope: Self-contained, no-narration component layout example only. Not native source reproduction or a voiced narration example.
example.nativeReproduction: Not self-contained; needs its actual authorized matching original narration/video and complete captions. Do not insert another paragraph or generate paid media as a substitute.

narrationProductionRouting.existingProjects: Keep the existing project workflow. Do not silently convert an approved project.
narrationProductionRouting.newProduction: Read the declared routes before selecting scenes. Audio/script without a presenter can use this template-bound component workflow. If native scene durations or meanings do not fit, use this existing route instead of repeatedly forcing short phrases into a long static native scene. Preserve the presenter when supplied; do not mix independent engines into an unsupported timeline.
narrationProductionRouting.timing: Reuse available local speech recognition first; retain its raw records. Recover from unavailable transcription tools without changing approvals or inventing timings.
narrationProductionRouting.assistantAction: Choose and bind the supported route inside the existing production flow; do not make the user select technical workflows or supply the same materials again.

beforeFirstCheck.cueCondition: follow-speech affects steps only with complete genuine cues; partial groups keep original reveal fallback. Never invent cues.
beforeFirstCheck.legacy: Omitted/original preserves existing inputs; the report never mutates a project.
beforeFirstCheck.review: Inspect content/caption clearance and subject entry at scene openings, not only the middle. Keep normal approval gates.

newNarrationWithHighlight.condition: Select for a newly composed narrated film containing highlight. Preserve the omitted mode of approved old projects; use a fresh input/plan and inspect complete real-font capacity.

newProductionComposition.legacy: No automatic changes without the explicit profile
newProductionComposition.steps: Missing genuine cues deliberately defer step following without changing original SFX

firstReply: 这个模板可按你的内容编排已有动画，先看[官网示例](https://media.openaicut.com/previews/605/draft-zh-99e0d21cfdd9.mp4)。你这期要表达什么，已有文稿、口播或素材可以直接提供。

fit.summary: 现代图文口播完整原生动作库
goodFor: 有语义依据的主张、拆解、证据、过程、归纳与收尾
按内容选择原生完整组，保留动作与状态接力
notFor: 任意数量硬塞固定数量组
编造不存在的步骤、证据或结果

rules: 先读取完整口播、原文和实际字幕时间，以完整人声及字幕的结束时刻确定全片时长；样片长度和单镜头容量都不是整片上限。
先按完整内容列出语义段落，再依据实际句子/短语边界安排多个镜头。一个主题可以跨多个镜头；一个语义段也可拆成多个相容镜头。
优先使用本模板同风格的原生组、已实现的基础表达及合法相邻组合；必要时重复组的独立实例并绑定各自内容。不要默认跨风格拼接或退化成静态底图。
单组放不下时，依次重新分段、增加或更换同风格镜头、在声明的安静阅读区合法停留，再重新绑定cue。动作仍按原速，真人、人声和字幕连续使用输出时钟。
cue越界、动作保护窗冲突或当前候选未匹配，只说明当前镜头方案失败；检查多个完整分段方案后重试，不能据此断言整片只能15–19秒或要求用户剪短。
素材名冲突、rc版本报错及依赖错误属于工具问题，保留准确日志并排查，不能当作文案太长或模板时长上限。
所有分段与候选方案覆盖同一条完整口播；不删句、不丢限定词、不通过改小narrationDuration掩盖缺口。导出前检查首句、末句、总帧数、字幕与人声完整覆盖。
只有用户明确要求精简或平台存在已确认的硬性时长限制时，才提出剪辑建议并让用户核对改稿；当前风格能力确实不足时列出具体缺口，不夸称一定能原样适配任意内容。
以真实口播时长和整数帧规划；所有段总帧数必须一致
每组仍执行自己的原速动作、停留、素材和尾声合同
长片须绑定覆盖全片的授权配乐；默认曲不够长时补素材，不循环冒充完整

materials.ifMissing: 有纯口播音频时，使用已声明的 motion-kit 路线绑定原声与真实字幕，不绑定人物来源；没有音频时按用户目标处理已有文稿。不再索取已给材料，不把原生隐藏人物说成已经实现。

materials.ask: 文稿或 SRT 一起提供，助手翻译和核对时间

materials.use: 完整文稿、画幅、证据与真实动作锚点
materials.ask: 这条视频最想表达什么，需要横屏还是竖屏
materials.ifMissing: 先理解已有材料并给方案，不让用户填写复杂参数

inputPolicy: 核对已有上下文和本期媒体；保留否定、条件、数字、实体与顺序。只有文稿时先安排内容；授权生成配音或示意媒体后取得真实时长与对齐，再进入制作，不自动用 demo 人物替换用户。
selection: 共 26 个完整原生/恢复组；命名为 style:group。局部固定数量只约束对应组，内容不符时换组；不得删除原动作或用通用卡片冒充原生编舞。

styles.title: 连续形变 · 目标与干扰（恢复组）

demoPolicy: 仅明确要求演示时使用。主片展示7组完整原生动画，26组逐项目录另附；7.5秒可执行小样用于验证正常制作入口，和117.4667秒动作巡演用途不同。人物是获准使用的AI静态示意，声音由MotionGit标准男声合成，没有口型同步。

captions.pairing: 同一真实句级时间，英文为忠实翻译
captions.layout: 默认显示中文，翻译参考保留；真实短句一行，声明时最多两明确行，不使用浏览器自动换行
captions.highlight: 仅用 ASR 或核验的真实中文词区间驱动逐字扫色，不按字数估计
captions.endPunctuation: 仅显示层清理结尾逗号、句号；原文、内部标点与词时间不变

nativeContract.scope: Native media.captions file only; component timeline.captions uses its own public schema
nativeContract.container: Nonempty JSON array, not a wrapper object, SRT, JavaScript assignment or parallel language arrays
nativeContract.clock: Finite seconds on the original audio clock; 0 <= previous.t1 <= t0 < t1 <= real narration duration. Nonblank zh/en each occupy one explicit line. Do not cut or stretch audio to fit captions.
nativeContract.wordClock: highlight.source is asr-word-boundaries or verified-word-boundaries; highlight.language equals primaryLanguage; units is a nonempty array of exactly text/start/end. Units stay ordered inside their cue (existing 0.001-second tolerance); end >= start. Concatenated unit text equals the complete primary-language line exactly, including punctuation. Keep actual original recognition/listening records; a label and valid JSON do not certify alignment.
nativeContract.exampleWarning: Illustrative structure and invented example times only. Never reuse these times, source label or text as evidence for a real production.

sentenceOnly.instruction: If only genuine sentence timing is available, use the declared component workflow and its complete sentence captions/narrationMap. Keep original times and meaning. Do not manufacture units, repeatedly guess native keys, force paid ASR, switch templates, unpack protected runtime or ask users for technical forms. Existing native projects retain their native contract.

workflow: inspect user media and full narration
paired bilingual captions and real word alignment
inspect plan/report and set review.json reviewed=true after real review
inspect stills and set preview.json reviewed=true after real review
render → encoded motion/audio review → owner artistic review

tip.variantsNote: banner 横幅展开、色块砸入（warn 带滚动警示条）/ card 图标徽章弹跳落下、卡片展开 / bubble 圆形角色 + 气泡逐字打出

checklist.label: 待办清单
checklist.use: 逐项完成的清单：准备步骤、检查项、已做到的事。和 list 的区别是有打勾过程、进度计数和最后的完成章

done.label: 完成章文字（默认 完成）

checklist.variantsNote: todo 玻璃面板 + 计数 + 进度条，完成章砸下 / clipboard 写字板手绘勾与划线、圆章盖下 / progress 分段进度环与清单同步、光点飞入

vs.label: 两方对决
vs.use: 两个对象正面比拼 1–3 项数值并分出胜负：产品 A/B、方案、两个人或团队。只比观点不比数值时用 compare

src.label: 头像/图片（可省略，省略时显示首字）

low.label: true 表示越小越好（价格、耗时）

vs.variantsNote: fight 格斗游戏式冲入相撞、VS 闪电、属性条对冲、胜方光环王冠 / scale 头像滚入、双色比例条拔河 / cards 对战卡牌飞入翻开、逐项比数值、胜方浮起 WIN

donut.label: 环形占比
donut.use: 几个部分占整体多少：构成、份额、预算分配、用户来源（2–5 项）。数值按占比换算成百分比

center.label: ring 变体：中心合计上方小字（如「总计」）

donut.variantsNote: ring 环形 + 引线标注、中心合计滚动 / pie 实心扇区逐块弹出 / split 环形 + 侧边图例逐条点亮

linechart.label: 折线趋势
linechart.use: 随时间的变化：增长、下降、波动、两条对比（4–12 个点）。终点标注最后一个值

series.label: 系列名（第二个对应 value2）

note.label: 终点标注补充（如「创新高」）

value2.label: 第二条线（每个点都填才画）

linechart.variantsNote: line 描线生长 + 拖尾光点 + 数据点弹出 / area 面积弹起 + 扫描线读数 / spark 大数字跟随走势 + 涨跌幅（只画第一条）

counter.label: KPI 数字卡
counter.use: 2–4 个关键数字并排：用户数、营收、增长率、时长；可带涨跌
counter.variantsNote: cards 三维翻牌 + 滚动计数 / odometer 里程表滚轮逐位停 / ticker 行情板逐行扫入、乱码锁定

progress.label: 进度 / 完成度
progress.use: 完成了多少：项目进度、目标达成、技能熟练度、电量式的程度（1–4 条，百分比）
progress.variantsNote: bars 斜纹横条（100% 打勾）/ rings 同心环 + 中心轮显 / battery 分段电量格（颜色随电量）

timeline.label: 时间线 / 里程碑
timeline.use: 按时间顺序的 3–6 个节点：发展历程、计划路线图、事件经过；current 标出「现在」

current.label: 当前节点序号（1 起，默认最后一个；之后的节点显示为计划中）

timeline.variantsNote: horizontal 横向沿线点亮（竖屏自动纵向）/ vertical 竖线 + 卡片滑入 / zigzag 折线上下交替

table.label: 对比表 / 功能矩阵
table.use: 2–3 个方案在 2–5 项上逐项比较；单元格写 ✓ / ✗ 或短文字；赢家列高亮

cells.label: 各方案的值（与 cols 同序；✓ ✗ 画成图标）

win.label: 赢家列序号（1 起；不写时取 ✓ 最多的唯一一列）

table.variantsNote: grid 表格逐行扫入 + 赢家列光框 / scorecard 每方案一张卡、赢家抬起戴冠 / checklist 盖章清单 + 底部计票

ranking.label: 排行榜
ranking.use: 3–6 项按数值排名：榜单、名次、Top N；自动按 value 从大到小排序

meaning: 每项出现（race 按输入顺序；podium / list 从末名到第一）

ranking.variantsNote: race 条形赛跑后重新排序换位 / podium 领奖台升起 + 鼓点揭晓第一 / list 名次牌自下而上翻入

flow.label: 流程图
flow.use: 3–6 个有先后顺序的环节（步骤、流水线、因果链），或一个起点分出多个去向（branch）；节点可带图标

nodes.label: 节点（branch 变体：第一个是起点，其余是分支）

meaning: 每个节点出现（连线在它之前描出）

flow.variantsNote: chain 单行（竖屏单列）箭头链 / snake 两行折返 / branch 一个起点分出多个分支

cycle.label: 循环图
cycle.use: 首尾相接、周而复始的 3–6 个环节：飞轮、迭代闭环、生命周期；中心可写主题
cycle.variantsNote: ring 圆环 + 弧形箭头逐段描出 / orbit 节点在椭圆轨道上绕转 / wheel 扇区转盘轮流弹出

funnel.label: 漏斗 / 层级
funnel.use: 逐层收窄的转化、筛选（funnel），或自下而上的层级、金字塔、技术栈（pyramid / layers）；每层可带一个数值

layers.label: 从上到下（金字塔从塔尖到塔底）

meaning: 每层出现（funnel 自上而下，pyramid / layers 自下而上）

funnel.variantsNote: funnel 漏斗逐层落下、粒子流过 / pyramid 金字塔自下而上 / layers 等轴测叠层板

venn.label: 交集图
venn.use: 两三个概念的交集或合成：A + B 的重叠点、三者兼得；merge 变体表示合而为一

center.label: 交集 / 合成后的文字

venn.variantsNote: overlap 圆从两侧靠拢重叠、交集闪光 / outline 轮廓描出、交集斜纹填满 / merge 汇合成一个大圆

mindmap.label: 思维导图
mindmap.use: 一个主题展开 3–6 个方面，每个方面可再列 0–2 个要点：知识框架、话题拆解
mindmap.variantsNote: radial 放射状（竖屏上下两排）/ tree 右展树（竖屏左侧主干）/ bubbles 气泡簇漂浮

matrix.label: 2×2 象限
matrix.use: 两个维度把事物分成四类：重要/紧急、投入/回报、定位分析；可在象限里落几个点，priority 变体突出一个象限

quads.label: 四个象限：左上、右上、左下、右下

pick.label: priority 变体突出的象限（1–4，默认 2 右上）

meaning: 点落入 / 重点象限放大

matrix.variantsNote: quadrant 十字轴 + 象限翻起 / scatter L 形坐标 + 网格 + 扫描线 / priority 四色象限、重点放大其余变暗

hub.label: 中心辐射
hub.use: 一个核心连接 3–8 个周边：平台与生态、能力清单、一个工具对接多个场景

meaning: 每个卫星出现（连线先射出）

hub.variantsNote: star 环形卫星卡 + 信号往返 / grid 两列（竖屏上下两排）电路折线 / constellation 星点 + 星座连线

lowerthird.label: 人名条
lowerthird.use: 第一次出现某个人、讲者、嘉宾或角色时标出名字和身份；也可当一条短字幕条。贴在左下（或右下），横屏在口播卡左侧、字幕之上

icon.label: 没有头像时用的图标（可省略）

side.label: 贴左还是贴右（默认 left）

lowerthird.variantsNote: bar 色块 + 擦条推出深色名字条与主色头衔条 / glass 玻璃卡三维翻入、头像描圈 / line 细线描出、名字从线上升起（极简）

callout.label: 箭头标注
callout.use: 指出画面里的某个位置（录屏按钮、图片细节、口播卡外的内容）：给目标点 x/y（0–1 画面比例）和一句短标注

text.label: 标注文字，*重点* 用星号

x.label: 目标点横向位置（画面比例）

y.label: 目标点纵向位置（画面比例）

w.label: box 变体：框宽（画面比例）

h.label: box 变体：框高（画面比例）

meaning: 箭头 / 圈 / 框画出

callout.variantsNote: arrow 手绘弯箭头指向目标 + 波纹 / circle 手绘圈出目标 + 引线 / box 四角飞入框选、虚线流动

sticker.label: 贴纸
sticker.use: 给一句话盖个情绪章：「绝了」「重点」「NEW」「必看」，或一个图标贴纸。位置 x/y 可选（默认右上），不压口播卡和字幕

icon.label: 图标（可与文字同时用；都不给时为星星）

x.label: 中心横向位置（画面比例）

y.label: 中心纵向位置（画面比例）

meaning: 再强调一下（摇摆 / 盖章 / 再炸）

sticker.variantsNote: pop 白边贴纸从镜头前砸下压扁回弹 / badge 锯齿圆徽旋入、外圈慢转 / burst 漫画爆炸星弹开、边缘沸腾抖动

emoji.label: 表情飘赞
emoji.use: 情绪时刻的一阵表情：点赞、比心、火、笑。icon 用图标名（彩色圆泡），或 text 填 1–2 个 emoji 字符；n 为数量

text.label: emoji 字符（填了就不用 icon）

x.label: float / burst：起点横向位置（画面比例）

y.label: burst：喷射中心纵向位置（画面比例）

emoji.variantsNote: float 直播点赞从下往上飘、摇摆 / rain 从上落下弹跳停住 / burst 中心大表情心跳、分波向四周喷射

progressbar.label: 章节进度条
progressbar.use: 告诉观众「现在讲到第几部分」：2–6 个章节名 + 当前章节序号。放在章节切换处，停留 2–6 秒

title.label: 左侧 / 上方小标题（可省略）

progressbar.variantsNote: top 顶部分段条、指针滑过已完成段 / bottom 底部胶囊组、选中块弹性滑到当前章 / dots 节点步进器、当前节点展开成带名字的胶囊

tag.label: 角标
tag.use: 画面角落的话题标签、集数、属性：「#干货」「第 3 集」「新」，1–3 条，可整段常驻

items.label: 标签文字（第一条为主标签）

pos.label: 左上 tl / 右上 tr（默认 tl）

tag.variantsNote: corner 角落叠块斜切滑入、红点闪 / pill 胶囊组弹落、轮流点亮 / ribbon 燕尾斜丝带展开、轻飘

confetti.label: 庆祝特效
confetti.use: 里程碑、达成、好消息、结尾致谢：彩纸 / 烟花，可选一句短字居中弹出。每个 cue 一波（最多 3 波）
confetti.variantsNote: cannons 两侧礼花炮向内喷出 / rain 彩纸从顶上飘落 + 闪星 / fireworks 烟花升空炸开

frame.label: 画面装饰框
frame.use: 给整段画面加氛围：拍摄感取景框、录制中、霓虹边框。框住内容区（避开口播卡与字幕），可整段常驻

label.label: 角落 / 上边框小字（可省略）

frame.variantsNote: viewfinder 四角取景框飞入、对焦框确认 / rec 开机展开 + 红点 REC 时间码 + 扫描线 / glow 霓虹边框描出、光点环绕

gallery.label: 图集
gallery.use: 3–8 张图片/视频一起亮相：作品集、案例合集、活动照片、产品多角度；每个 cue 出一张（carousel/stack 是每个 cue 转到下一张）

src.label: 图片或视频（省略时为中性占位）

meaning: grid：每张翻入；carousel / stack：第一张出现，之后每个 cue 换到下一张

gallery.variantsNote: grid 网格错峰三维翻入后轮流放大 / carousel 3D 旋转木马逐张转到正前 / stack 照片堆一张张甩向两侧

beforeafter.label: 前后对比
beforeafter.use: 同一对象改造前后、修图前后、旧版新版：两张素材对照，第二个 cue 揭示 after
beforeafter.variantsNote: slider 分割线扫过揭示并来回轻扫 / flip 卡片三维翻面 / split 并排后 before 压暗退后、after 推近

kenburns.label: 纪录片推拉
kenburns.use: 讲故事、回顾、旅程、案例背景：1–4 张图片纪录片式慢推慢移、交叉溶解，底部逐字打出说明；每个 cue 换一张
kenburns.variantsNote: pan 横向慢移 / zoom 交替推近拉远 / parallax 虚化背景 + 前景小窗反向视差

polaroid.label: 拍立得
polaroid.use: 生活感、回忆、幕后花絮、团队/人物照片：1–4 张照片卡 + 手写说明；每个 cue 出一张
polaroid.variantsNote: drop 掉落弹跳后显影 / pin 拍在软木板上钉住、红线相连 / film 胶片条滚过、当前格放大

device.label: 设备样机
device.use: 展示 App、网页、录屏、作品画面：素材放进手机 / 平板 / 显示器屏幕里，视频按成片时钟播放；可配标题

src.label: 屏幕内容（图片或视频，省略时为占位）

title.label: 标题（横屏在右、竖屏在上）

device.variantsNote: phone 手机三维旋入 / tablet 平板从平放立起 / monitor 显示器落位后开机亮线展开

collage.label: 拼贴墙
collage.use: 大量作品/截图/用户照片的气势感：作品墙、社区、合集封面。masonry / wall 用 4–9 张（不够会循环）；mosaic 只用第一张，碎片拼成整图
collage.variantsNote: masonry 瀑布流逐块落下后分列滚动 / mosaic 碎片飞入拼合成整图 / wall 多行无限滚动 + 中心高亮

spotlight.label: 聚光放大
spotlight.use: 在一张截图/照片/视频画面里依次指出 1–3 个关注点（x、y 为 0–1 的相对位置），每个点带一个短标签
spotlight.variantsNote: spotlight 暗场聚光圈移动 / magnifier 放大镜跟随 / blur 其余区域虚化

kinetic.label: 逐行动态排版
kinetic.use: 一句有节奏的观点拆成 2–5 个短行，跟着口播一行一行冲出来；适合开场钩子、口号、情绪句
kinetic.variantsNote: stack 按字数撑满宽度、左右交替滑入 / beat 一次一行居中砸入、推镜头 / wave 逐字波浪弹起

highlight.label: 重点词标记
highlight.use: 一句完整的话里有 1–2 个必须被看见的词（用 *星号* 标出）：先出整句，再在重点上画标记

text.label: 整句，*重点* 用星号包住

highlight.variantsNote: marker 荧光笔涂过 / circle 手绘圈出 / underline 波浪下划线 + 放大

scramble.label: 乱码解码
scramble.use: 揭晓一个名字、术语、答案、代号：乱码逐位锁定。科技、数据、揭秘类内容
scramble.variantsNote: decode 原地逐位锁定 / matrix 字符雨中逐字落下 / terminal 终端输入命令 + 回车出结果

rotator.label: 轮换词
rotator.use: 同一句话换不同的词：「适合 学生 / 老师 / 公司」、「它能 写 / 画 / 剪」。最后一个词停住
rotator.variantsNote: slot 老虎机滚轮 / flip 三维翻牌 / type 删除后重新输入

marquee.label: 滚动横幅
marquee.use: 一串关键词/标签/口号持续滚动：活动、清单很长、节奏型过渡；可在横幅上砸入一个大词

kicker.label: ticker 变体左侧标签（默认 LIVE）

marquee.variantsNote: belt 两条交叉色带 / ticker 新闻滚动条 / wall 满屏描边大字

bigtype.label: 巨字
bigtype.use: 一个词撑满画面的冲击时刻：段落主题、结论词、品牌词；mask 变体可让图片/视频透过字显示

src.label: mask 变体：透过字显示的图片/视频（可省略）

bigtype.variantsNote: mask 素材透过巨字 / outline 描边后液体灌满 / split 光线切开上下错位

chat.label: 聊天对话
chat.use: 把一段对话演出来：用户与客服/朋友的聊天、群里的讨论、向 AI 助手提问并得到回答；2–6 条消息逐条出现

title.label: 顶栏名字（默认取对方名字 / 群聊 / AI 助手）

who.label: left 对方 / right 自己

text.label: 消息文字，*重点* 用星号；ai 变体的回答（left）可到 40 字

name.label: 发送者名字（thread 变体显示）

avatar.label: 头像图片（可省略，省略时显示首字母圆）

meaning: 每条消息出现（自己的消息在此刻发送；ai 回答从此刻开始流式输出）

chat.variantsNote: bubbles 手机聊天：输入框打字发送 / 对方正在输入三个点后弹出，自动上滚 / thread 宽面板群聊：头像 + 名字 / ai 助手问答：问题发出，回答逐字流式输出

comment.label: 评论 / 弹幕
comment.use: 展示观众反馈、网友评论、热评、弹幕刷屏：2–5 条评论逐条浮现，点赞数上涨，最高赞那条被强调（热评 / 置顶 / 放大停住）

title.label: 评论区标题（cards / pinned，可省略）

items.label: 评论（最高赞的一条会被强调）

text.label: 评论文字，*重点* 用星号

avatar.label: 头像（可省略，省略时显示首字母圆）

src.label: danmaku 变体：弹幕下面的播放画面（图片/视频，可省略）

meaning: 每条评论出现（弹幕发出）
最高赞那条被强调：盖热评章 / 置顶 / 放大停住

comment.variantsNote: cards 评论卡翻起浮现、点赞数增长、盖热评章 / danmaku 弹幕从右飞过播放画面，热评放大停在中央 / pinned 评论卡落下，最高赞那条被拎起移到最上方置顶

notify.label: 通知横幅
notify.use: 表现「消息来了」：订单、提醒、私信、系统通知一条接一条弹出；也可做锁屏收到通知的画面

app.label: 来源名称（中性，如「日程」「消息」）

date.label: lock 变体：锁屏日期，如「10 月 12 日 星期一」

meaning: 收尾：stack 展开成列表 / toast 按下「查看」/ lock 上滑提示

notify.variantsNote: stack 从顶部依次滑下叠成一摞、铃铛角标跳动，最后展开 / toast 中心弹窗依次弹出，最后按下查看 / lock 锁屏亮起、通知滑入、手机震动

search.label: 搜索框
search.use: 演示「搜一下」：输入关键词 → 回车 → 联想/结果出现、命中词高亮；适合讲搜索热度、怎么找资料、工具里的命令面板

placeholder.label: 输入前的占位文字（默认「搜索」）

items.label: 联想词 / 结果（命中搜索词的部分自动高亮）

desc.label: 说明（spotlight 一行；results 最多两行）

meaning: 选中 / 打开第一条（最佳匹配）

search.variantsNote: bar 大搜索框展开、打字、联想列表下拉 / spotlight 背景压暗的居中命令面板、方向键选中后回车 / results 结果页：加载条 + 骨架屏，结果卡片替换骨架，第一条标最佳匹配

recipes.rule: Read the original scene material, palette, typography, framing and motion first; choose the matching profile per scene. Never assume one appearance fits all templates.
recipes.limitPolicy: Style recommendations are advisory; actual final visual review determines acceptance.

recipes.scenario: 已有文案需要强调一个观点
recipes.rule: 提炼用户真实主张；不把原话前缀当摘要。cues 取句级实测或人工核验锚点，没有词对齐时不声称逐字同步。

recipes.scenario: 数量变化或真实数据比较
recipes.rule: 只使用有来源的数值，显示单位和时间口径；没有数值依据时改用观点控件，不生成装饰性统计。

recipes.scenario: 存在录屏、截图、产品图或实拍
recipes.rule: 绑定本期真实素材及完整可用区间；截图、证据、logo 默认 contain，cover 需显式焦点。前后对比必须有对应同类实物，不替换成占位纹理。
叠加控件写在 timeline.overlays，检查字幕、人物脸与动作路径，避免只增加装饰而没有内容推进。

recipes.scenario: 讲两项或多项并列经验
recipes.rule: 按原稿实际数量选控件及容量，不为固定三项模板凑第三项；超容量就分段。

recipes.scenario: 回应一个真实疑问、误解或不同做法
recipes.rule: 保留原文否定、条件和边界；引述评论必须有来源，不伪造用户或点赞数。
保留真实视频与音轨，使用 card/small/hide 三种人物布局；每个画幅分别检查眼口、肩部、字幕和人物安全区。无视频可省略人物，有声时长由真实音频决定。

extensionLibrary.modeSelection: Explicit workflow:'motion-kit' uses the added control library; omit workflow to retain the original native parameter contract.
extensionLibrary.execution: Use the same official motion run plan/prepare/preview/render entry; personal Key remains in the parent .motion and host APIs.

updates.compatibilityCommand: node motion-kit/tools/compare-contract.mjs <old merged spec> <new merged spec>
updates.migration: Compare control IDs, props, variants, timing/media contracts; produce a new reviewed plan and project for incompatible changes.
updates.rollback: Retain and select the preceding source-verified .motion release.

light.description: Native light editorial/gallery panels with blue emphasis

dark.description: Native black review chapters with blue emphasis

styleProfiles.selection: Read the original scene material, palette, typography, framing and motion first; choose the matching profile per scene. Never assume one appearance fits all templates.
styleProfiles.freezePolicy: New library versions require a new verified template release and visual review; no hot replacement.

timeCorner.behavior: Output timecode → animated circular ornament → timecode, with complementary fades.
timeCorner.production: The time corner is part of this template’s visual design. The preview and render entries compose it consistently, including text-animation extensions.
timeCorner.background: Official lighter/path variant selected from the actual frame under the reserved corner.
timeCorner.clock: Final output frame time; independent from source choreography.
timeCorner.shortVideos: A visible signature window is also retained for videos shorter than seven seconds.

rules: 先读取完整口播、原文和实际字幕时间，以完整人声及字幕的结束时刻确定全片时长；样片长度和单镜头容量都不是整片上限。
先按完整内容列出语义段落，再依据实际句子/短语边界安排多个镜头。一个主题可以跨多个镜头；一个语义段也可拆成多个相容镜头。
优先使用本模板同风格的原生组、已实现的基础表达及合法相邻组合；必要时重复组的独立实例并绑定各自内容。不要默认跨风格拼接或退化成静态底图。
单组放不下时，依次重新分段、增加或更换同风格镜头、在声明的安静阅读区合法停留，再重新绑定cue。动作仍按原速，真人、人声和字幕连续使用输出时钟。
cue越界、动作保护窗冲突或当前候选未匹配，只说明当前镜头方案失败；检查多个完整分段方案后重试，不能据此断言整片只能15–19秒或要求用户剪短。
素材名冲突、rc版本报错及依赖错误属于工具问题，保留准确日志并排查，不能当作文案太长或模板时长上限。
所有分段与候选方案覆盖同一条完整口播；不删句、不丢限定词、不通过改小narrationDuration掩盖缺口。导出前检查首句、末句、总帧数、字幕与人声完整覆盖。
只有用户明确要求精简或平台存在已确认的硬性时长限制时，才提出剪辑建议并让用户核对改稿；当前风格能力确实不足时列出具体缺口，不夸称一定能原样适配任意内容。

audioIntegrity.beforeExport: Verify original narration, final encoded mix and actual listening; do not infer human speech from SFX or stream duration

narrationAlignment.meaningAcceptance: Listen and inspect actual encoded frames; ASR and structural timing are not semantic acceptance

componentCaptionAndExport.previewEvidence: captionSamples: actual subtitle bounds and center in output pixels
componentCaptionAndExport.export: preflight output parents, validate encoded media, preserve derived recovery media on failure, verify published bytes

narrationVisualDevelopment.scope: Current optional narration enhancement; preserve existing projects, native audio/action clocks and current signed delivery identity.
narrationVisualDevelopment.assistant: Assign every complete sentence an actual visual expression and continuing state. Read visualCoverage warnings, then inspect encoded frames. Do not count subtitles, particles or random movement as sentence illustration.
narrationVisualDevelopment.clock: Use real cues and preserve all speech. Whole-sentence times cannot justify guessed word or left/right timings.
narrationVisualDevelopment.materials: Use provided media and compatible native expressions. Optional missing imagery must not block the existing workflow or trigger paid generation.
narrationVisualDevelopment.compatibility: Warnings are advisory. Preserve original routes, approvals, native action clocks, audio, update entry and approved old projects.
narrationVisualDevelopment.newProduction: For new productions use timeline.narrationLayout=balanced for content-sized lists, steps, comparisons, pros/cons cards, completion-mark clearance and icon cards. Each template retains its own palette/material and action/sound clocks. With complete measured step cues, timeline.narrationVisualMode=follow-speech hides future labels until their cues. The prior narrationCardLayout option still controls icon cards only. The assistant selects these options without extra user steps. Omitted/original preserves approved old compositions. Explicit narration cues retain focus without guessed word ordering.

currentNarrationRelease.delivery: Use the verified personal package entry and currentTemplate identity. Prior author/source review notes are historical; they do not require another account, key or tool.

consumerDemo.policy: Author preset paths describe source examples. Never execute python adapter/run.py or search an unpacked protected core from a personal package. Use the verified bundled helper and its declared workflow. A style-preview request does not authorize installing a renderer or generating media.
consumerDemo.previewAccess: Open the public style preview in a browser or request it with the transparent MotionGit User-Agent. A CDN 403/1010 for a default Python request does not mean the file is absent. Never send the package credential to a public media host.
consumerDemo.exampleInputs: Read presets/component-layout.json for the explicit no-narration component layout example. Historical presets/demo.json is not self-contained: its exact missing inputs are listed in inputRoutingContract.example. Do not mistake this example for a native or voiced film. Use verified bundled helper normal workflow commands; no source extraction or guessed --demo flag.
consumerDemo.nativeReproduction: Reproduce only with the declared native inputs and actual supported plan/prepare/preview commands. Do not guess demo inputs, copy an author-directory command, add an unsupported --demo flag or report a component workflow as native reproduction.
consumerDemo.missingEvidence: Keep the complete Color conversion diagnostic and actual FFmpeg version. A successful signature/setup does not certify rendering; an author example path that is unavailable is an instruction defect, not a protection prohibition.

selfContainedExample.scope: Self-contained, no-narration component layout example only. Not native source reproduction or a voiced narration example.
selfContainedExample.nativeReproduction: Not self-contained; needs its actual authorized matching original narration/video and complete captions. Do not insert another paragraph or generate paid media as a substitute.

consumerDiagnostics.stages: Signature, dependency setup, environment doctor, input validation, planning, preview and encoded export are separate results. A failure at one stage does not prove that this computer or the whole template is unsupported.
consumerDiagnostics.environment: Use the verified bundled helper. Setup prepares declared isolated dependencies; the helper can prepare its automation browser if absent. Setup does not upgrade host FFmpeg. Keep the actual executable version and complete diagnostic, fix the named missing capability, then retry the same inputs in fresh output paths.
consumerDiagnostics.recovery: Read the actual error before choosing a recovery. Do not substitute author commands, manually unpack protected code, replace original media, silently change audio choices, or call a component preview a native reproduction. Preserve the old package, original Key, source media and editable projects.
consumerDiagnostics.feedback: If still blocked, prepare the existing sanitized feedback draft with current verified version, failing stage, full bounded error and steps. Show the draft and obtain consent before submitting conversation or file excerpts. A prepared draft is not a submitted report.
consumerDiagnostics.nativeColor: The native color-conversion route requires FFmpeg 9+ with the libswscale transfer/primaries mapping features checked by doctor. A matching version number alone is insufficient. Keep this color policy; do not replace the conversion with metadata tags.

consumerReview.plan: After plan succeeds, read the complete generated plan/report.json and the source-bound parameters/input receipts. Check the current user meaning, actual materials, selected groups and durations. Only after this inspection, set reviewed=true in that plan directory's existing review.json, preserving every hash, schema and sourceBinding field; then use the declared prepare @vault command. There is no invented approve CLI command.
consumerReview.preview: Open and inspect the actual images listed by the prepared project's preview.json for text, crop, overlaps, safe zones and timing. Only after inspection, set reviewed=true in that existing preview.json without altering its bound hashes, image list or source identity, then run the declared render. A content or source change requires a fresh plan/project and new previews.
consumerReview.scope: Assistant technical review does not claim user artistic approval. Keep any user approval already required by this workflow. Never mark a failed or uninspected plan/preview reviewed.

continuousNarration.scope: Declared component timeline only; native brief ownershipRefs unchanged
continuousNarration.captionRule: Keep original whole cues, actual start/end and exactly intersecting captionIndices across visual cuts; no duplicate subtitles or audio
continuousNarration.timingRule: Use complete sentence beats unless this exact route verifies genuine word evidence; never invent word time
continuousNarration.assistant: Choose actual visible sentence targets and complete the public inputs; do not ask users for technical forms

contentHeader.assistant: For portrait, put visible titles in the existing scene content controls. Auxiliary corner title/chapter fields remain readable for planning but are hidden. Landscape keeps its current contract.
contentHeader.compatibility: Normal legacy preview remains available when old inputs contain no wording; the receipt reports needs-current-copy. The assistant completes header.shortTitle from the current script before final delivery, without a new API charge or user technical form.
contentHeader.fallback: Renderer may extract a verbatim complete sentence from already bound title/caption/copy fields and records bound-excerpt plus its field path. Preserve negation, numbers and units. Without current copy report needs-current-copy; do not invent.
contentHeader.legacy: Existing packages and projects are preserved. Bind the header in a new revision; closed old HUD does not disable this independently managed content title.
contentHeader.portrait: Disabled: do not add a separate portrait corner title. Existing header input remains readable for compatibility.

portraitPublishing.sourceDistinction: Identify template captions separately from burned-in source captions. DOM success never certifies source pixels.
portraitPublishing.assistant: Reserve subtitle, subject/title, bottom description and right button regions in the existing layout. Inspect actual media frames, preserve essential visible content using contain/appropriate windowing, and re-layout only the conflicting region. Never crop important content automatically, erase source text, shrink/move everything, invent times, or ask the user for technical forms.
portraitPublishing.review: Actual encoded whole/word captions, short/long cues, subject/photo/video; measured rectangles plus labelled variable-interface occlusion simulation.

visibleRectangle.supported: Rectangular CSS inset with axis-aligned positive 2D scale/translation
visibleRectangle.unsupported: Conservative original bounds; never exempt unknown/rotated shapes
visibleRectangle.preservation: Original layout, complete subject/text, media, word clocks and native capacity unchanged

narrationPurposeContract.instruction: Choose from actual meaning. A listed enum is not permission to use any scene. Do not retry labels until validation passes, invent timing, or remove speech. Compose compatible expressions; semantic review remains required.

highlightReadability.scope: All three highlight variants only; all other controls unchanged
highlightReadability.newProduction: Assistant selects explicitly for new complete highlight text; retain preferred font and full meaning. Final ending=cut retains clear text without extending audio/video or changing cues/SFX. Inspect actual encoded sound film.

narrationComposition.sourceCopyReview: normal narrationChoices.composition lists exact visible comparison phrases and full source quote; never semantic approval

nativeOwnershipClock.characterUnit: contentEvidence.units.start/end are exact original-text offsets, not seconds
nativeOwnershipClock.source: The normal native plan binds media.captions highlight.units measured word intervals
nativeOwnershipClock.failure: Missing real word clocks, changed source text, duplicate/missing/reordered ownership and actual scene overflow remain errors
nativeOwnershipClock.acceptance: Source consumption only; semantics, original speech and final film still require review

portraitTalkingRepair.presenter: Portrait small inputs use the normal presenter carrier, never an automatic lower-right icon. Native626 groups are included; no cue/audio retiming.
portraitTalkingRepair.cornerTitle: Portrait output keeps the time/circle mark, without a second title or auxiliary chapter HUD beside it. Main scene content remains.
portraitTalkingRepair.oldProjects: Original packages and projects remain unchanged. Use the original package for exact historical layout replay.
